story:
Manley Ohana Flooring & Demolition is Kalani Manley. He has been taking floors out of Central Florida homes and buildings for twelve years, and MANLEYOHANA, LLC has been a registered Florida company operating out of Orlando since 2015.

'Ohana means family. On a lot of contractors' trucks that would be decoration; here it is a description of how the business runs. There is no sales rep who quotes your job and disappears, no dispatcher, no subcontracted crew arriving in an unmarked van. Kalani walks the job, gives you the number, and is the person on the ride-on scraper the morning it starts. If you want to know what that looks like, every photo on this site is one of his — pulled straight from the work, not from a stock library.

Flooring removal and interior demolition are the entire business, not the annoying step before selling you a new floor. That is why the machine is already loaded, why the vacuum shrouds are already on it, and why the slab gets ground flat and swept instead of left for somebody else. It also means we have no reason to talk you into a product — we are not selling one.

The work runs from Orlando and Windermere out to Merritt Island, Cocoa Beach and Rockledge: oceanfront condos, estate homes, occupied office suites, and a Merritt Island great room with a coffered ceiling nobody was allowed to touch. Residential or commercial, the job is the same one — the old floor comes out clean, the dust stays contained, the debris leaves with us, and the slab is ready for whatever goes down next.
